answer: The river counter is kept in bridge and wharf publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4338 identities would post 3154 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
